---
name: A check gave the wrong result
about: A check passed, failed, or was marked not-applicable when it should not have been
title: ""
labels: check-accuracy
---

**Which check**
The check title (and its code if you can see it, like S1 or A5).

**What it said, and what is actually true**
What status it gave (pass, fix, verify, or not-applicable), and what the correct answer is for your project.

**Your project**
Stack, host, and anything that explains the mismatch (for example, "I do have a database, it is Neon").
